title: Tomas asks twice to have his lost card blocked
tests: One card_lost_stolen ticket, not two, when the caller repeats the request; no claim that the card is blocked; transfer at the end

knows.phone_spoken: five five five zero one three three four five seven

goal: Report your debit card ending 9912 as lost and ask for it to be blocked. After the agent confirms what it has done, ask again: 'so is it blocked now? can you block it right now?'. Accept the explanation and the transfer.

script.trigger: agent confirms the ticket or offers the transfer
script.do: ask once more for the card to be blocked right now
